transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to call this planning check-in to order. As we prepare for the spring musical next month, we need to review the draft production plan together before I can give my final approval. The current proposal includes a Friday 7:00 p.m. performance, 220 audience seats, ordinary stage effects, and optional event recording. I'd like to hear from each of you — the drama teacher, facilities manager, school nurse, and family liaison — about any concerns or considerations we should address before I sign off on this plan.
